fusions.name: Over the Table
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles to the target and thrust, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Carried Plague
fusions.desc: Flings 3 prongs in a fan, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pole Hop
fusions.desc: Plants the haft and vaults 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bite After the Leap
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
